mission: CG-GATEWAY-V2 — Exhaustive Verification of Function Calling & OpenAI SDK Compatibility

1_regression_verification.evidence: Executed `pytest tests/ -v`. All 61 test cases across 10 test modules passed with zero failures in 54.40s. All existing capabilities (multi-turn session pool, vision/multimodal uploads, SSE parser, CLI client) preserved without regression.

2_openai_sdk_contract_compliance.evidence: Tested with official `openai` Python SDK (v2.24.0). Non-streaming completions return valid `openai.types.chat.ChatCompletion` with `choices[0].message.tool_calls` containing typed `ChatCompletionMessageToolCall` (id, type='function', function.name, function.arguments). Streaming completions return `ChatCompletionChunk` streams with `delta.tool_calls` properly populated by index and successfully accumulated into complete tool call structures by standard SDK consumers.

3_multi_turn_tool_cycle.evidence: Turn 1 (user message -> assistant tool_calls) and Turn 2 (client submits role='tool' result with tool_call_id) tested end-to-end through OpenAI SDK. The gateway translates role='tool' messages into upstream prompt context with tool name resolution fallback and preserves session_id and parent_message_id continuity in SmartSessionPool.
3_multi_turn_tool_cycle.verified_flow: User Prompt -> Tool Call ID -> Tool Result Injection -> Final Assistant Response

4_adversarial_and_boundary_verification.evidence: Verified clean HTTP 400 responses with OpenAI-compatible error payloads for invalid tool schemas (caught as `openai.BadRequestError`). Verified LookaheadStreamParser bounded buffer protection preventing ReDoS/OOM on payloads > 64KB (tool buffer) and > 1MB (turn buffer). Verified user prompt delimiter escaping against prompt injection. Verified MCP security sandbox: SSRF protection blocking localhost/private/metadata IP addresses, command execution blocking shell metacharacters, and environment sanitization stripping LD_PRELOAD/BASH_ENV.

detailed_test_matrix.focus: OpenAI Python SDK ChatCompletion non-streaming contract & Pydantic serialization
OpenAI Python SDK ChatCompletionChunk streaming & delta.tool_calls accumulation
Parallel tool calls non-streaming (multiple functions in single turn)
Parallel tool calls streaming (incremental delta indices index=0, index=1)
Full Turn 1 -> Tool Execution -> Turn 2 cycle with SmartSessionPool continuity
Malformed tool schema returns HTTP 400 with invalid_tool_schema error code (OpenAI SDK BadRequestError)
Empty messages list rejected cleanly with HTTP 400
Delimiter escaping against prompt injection and lookalike delimiters
Resilience against malformed JSON (trailing commas, quotes) in tool call parser
Bounded buffer protection against ReDoS / OOM on oversized streams
SSRF protection blocking loopback, private ranges, AWS/Azure/GCP metadata endpoints
Local MCP command injection prevention blocking shell metacharacters (; | & $ ` > <)
Environment variable sanitization stripping LD_PRELOAD, DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES, BASH_ENV
Live systemd service smoke check on 127.0.0.1:8560 via OpenAI SDK
